{{Quote|A friend of mine has informed me that an alien hate group has hired a bounty hunter to kidnap the Selonian ambassador. Since I am the Selonian ambassador, I find this news very disturbing.|Kathikiis Ruwahurr|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Kathikiis Ruwahurr''' was the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], a group of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that hated aliens threatened Ruwahurr and the ambassador's people. Ruwahurr endeavored to open a dialogue with them, but the alien haters showed no interest in peaceful talks. Soon after, they kidnapped Ruwahurr's assistant, a Selonian healer. Ruwahurr met a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was willing to help the ambassador. The spacer ambushed the alien haters, freed the assistant and escorted the Selonian to safety. Then Ruwahurr learned from a friend that the alien haters had hired a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] to kidnap the diplomat. Once again the ambassador could rely on the helpful adventurer who tracked down the bounty hunter and killed him in a fight to the death. Ruwahurr thanked the spacer and rewarded him with a small sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KathikiisRuwahurr.jpg|200px|thumb|Randomly generated depiction of Kathikiss Ruwahurr]]
[[File:TemplateSelonianScout.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Kathikiss Ruwahurr]]
Kathikiis Ruwahurr was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. The Selonian could be found in the [[Dearic Cantina]]. The NPC offered two small quests to players. For the first quest, the player had to travel to coordinates outside of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], fight a few low-level NPCs and escort the Selonian healer back to the Dearic cantina. For the second quest, the player had to travel to a location outside of Dearic again and kill the bounty hunter NPC.

Although Ruwahurr consistently spawned as a female Selonian, her appearance was randomized between one of thirty possible depictions.
